question: Within lung FACS and bladder droplet, do 3-to-24-month RNA differences reflect within-annotated-type change, captured population redistribution, or both?
decision: Identify whether independent follow-up needs within-population RNA/function, absolute population abundance, or both, without choosing a preferred RQ.
strongest_rival: True redistribution among populations can explain aggregate change without within-type change; differential capture, latent subtype mixtures and unbalanced sex can mimic either.
discriminator: Same-universe equal-mouse observed versus fixed young-composition summaries, within-type differences, exact composition/within-type/interaction/animal-covariance accounting and mouse-deletion sensitivity.
exposure_record: Paper, handwritten note, all previous Nb5 outputs and figures were inspected. Tissue/animal coverage and metadata fields were inspected before this freeze; new decomposition and tissue-local clone outcomes have not been calculated. Display genes inherit previous choices. This is exploratory reuse, not confirmation.
biological_unit: Deposited mouse within each assay and tissue; slash-containing lung IDs are explicitly pooled libraries, excluded from mouse-weighted expression contrasts and composition accounting.
nesting_and_overlap: Repeated tissue and assay samples and the general versus Figure 4 brain objects reuse mice/cells. IDs use different source formats. No cross-organ independence, canonical cross-assay identity resolution or external replication is asserted.
population_and_selection: Lung_facs and Bladder_droplet, individual mice at 3 and 24 months; common types present in every all-sex mouse, retained unchanged in male sensitivity. Complete previously fixed available marker family. Kidney common-support coverage only; whole-kidney inference held.
contrast: 24 minus 3 months, all observed sexes and male-only separately; cross-sectional, not paired animals or a sex-interaction test.
endpoint: Mean normalized RNA and detection proportion within the common captured-type universe, per-mouse standardized values and within-type contrasts.
methods: Methods, formulas, fixed display genes and biological rationale are specified in EXTENSION_STAGE1.md. Four exact additive terms include interaction and within-age animal covariance; no percent-explained statistic. Equal-mouse 3-month reference weights are exposed design choices fixed now. Leave-one-out fixes cell-type support, recomputes group means and retains every deletion. Independent count-based endpoint reconstruction and two analytic toy cases verify implementation.
missingness_and_exclusions: Pooled labels excluded. A type missing in any 3/24-month mouse is excluded from both observed-common and standardized endpoints, with omitted cells reported. No minimum captured-cell threshold is disguised as precision. Missing old females remain absent; kidney shared types are immune-only and lung droplet has no 24-month group.
multiplicity: No significance tests, selected positive subset, p-values or confirmatory thresholds. Retain complete prior marker family, all tissue descriptions, both age contrasts and failed eligibility.
precision_basis: Small existing mouse groups and sparse type/tissue cells; display animal estimates and deletion influence. No invented margin, power or independence across organs.
interpretation_limit: Within annotated type is not necessarily cell intrinsic; transcript detection/normalized mean does not establish senescence, secretion or repair. Composition terms describe captured proportions, not absolute abundance or causal mediation. Opposing components and small totals remain visible.
stop_rule: Stop on missing or changed inputs, duplicate identities, unsupported complete-tissue groups, nonfinite supported expression, failure of arithmetic checks or output errors. Preserve failure; amendments require new version.
amendment_reason: Owner authorized biologically focused extensions following the exposed descriptive pass. A new estimand and bounded comparison are specified in EXTENSION_STAGE1.md; previous results remain immutable.
